platform: Apple M4 Pro, macOS arm64, one thread
scope: Pure native UTC LTZ CEIL of genuine built-in integer epoch conversion with verified total integer operands and literal 0/3 or separately verified CASE 0/3/NULL precision; only release-supported units. Reuses the component timestamp builder and verified scalar-width specializations; the CEIL rebuild maps whole-millisecond component rounds with Arrow unary and shares parent validity. No transport, JNI or switch change.

method.input: Equal prepared GenericRowData/BinaryRowData and Arrow, both NULL modes, signed width extrema, epoch boundary/range/NULL values, integer seconds and milliseconds, runtime 0/3 precision. YEAR consumes the rounded timestamp as INT without discarding the round operation.
method.native_timer: Inside Rust after import and before export; production epoch/round/extraction kernels, output consumption, allocations, conversions and any intrinsic callbacks retained. Perimeter JNI/C Data and transposes excluded only from this prepared functionality timer.
method.previous: Actual preceding encoder/helper from recorded head on archived preceding native runtime and identical fixture, additive build-selected compatibility helper and production TableConfig. Setup requires intended rounding function in candidate native descriptors or previous JVM descriptors; candidate has no evaluators. Independent stock controls run in both JVMs.
method.pipeline: Six complete million-row, bounded row-source/blackhole jobs, one thread, two warmups and five alternating measurements per engine; submission/startup, JNI and both transposes retained. Surrounding JVM process startup outside job timer.

before_observation: Per release/JDK: eight positive invocations first match the complete first-query 5,003-row map/schema, then fail the intended empty-evaluator assertion. Further queries in those failed invocations are not reached. Retained/generated and catalog controls pass.

native_runtime_qualification.method: Fresh release rebuild passes all 915 Rust core tests. Fixed component widths above one millisecond map millisecond values with Arrow unary and reuse the sliced parent bitmap. The actual preceding runtime retains its archived 914-test qualification; no historical result is relabeled.

profile.method: Five-second native stack sample of the initial nullable runtime-precision/HOUR control on Flink 1.18, generic rows. Counts are inclusive sampled frames, not elapsed percentages.
profile.observation: 1886 inclusive TemporalRound frames, with append_nulls/append_value, per-row validity and timestamp reads below the fixed loop. Mapping the component millisecond buffer with Arrow unary reuses parent validity and avoids rebuilding it or appending zero fractions per row. The initial 0.943x stock bulk median, all initial jobs/trials and source/artifact provenance remain in this record.

limitations: Only verified total built-in epoch producers and release-supported UTC units; nonzero/regional zones, unknown/fallible producers, arbitrary/invalid precision and other units keep their prior correct routes. Same-name UDF identity is never inferred from text.
Unchanged released temporal-rounding tests run as separate stock oracles. Focused local tests are distinct from full hosted suites, which must qualify the exact pushed head.
Tiny cells, independent stock medians, variability and all complete-job results are retained. Prepared bulk speedups do not imply universal complete-job acceleration.
